text: dsh-enterprise-suite 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的企业连接器与插件工具集，包含 Atlassian、策略、审计插件和连接器模板。它通过 bundle 将插件接入 DSH，提供 Confluence 页面搜索、Jira 问题读取与创建、工单完整性检查、工具执行结果记录，以及生成独立连接器或策略插件项目的命令行工具。适合需要在 DSH 中连接 Atlassian、记录工具调用结果或创建插件项目的团队。Atlassian 默认使用 mock 模式；连接真实站点需配置站点地址及 Atlassian 凭据引用。

dsh-enterprise-suite adds Atlassian, policy, and audit plugins to DeepSeek Harness. It supports Confluence search, Jira issue reading and creation, and issue review. Its CLI scaffolds connector or policy plugins. Atlassian defaults to mock mode; live access needs a site and credential references.
想让 DSH 搜索 Confluence 页面并读取 Jira 工单。
有没有办法从 DSH 创建 Jira 问题，并检查工单内容是否完整？
I want DSH to connect to Atlassian for Confluence search and Jira issue workflows.
dsh-enterprise-suite 的功能「Atlassian 搜索与工单」：在 DSH 工具中搜索 Confluence 页面、读取 Jira 工单、创建 Jira 问题，并对工单摘要、描述、验收标准和优先级进行规则检查。
dsh-enterprise-suite 的功能「插件项目生成」：运行 create-dsh-enterprise-plugin 并提供项目名，可选 connector 或 policy 类型及输出路径；命令按模板创建独立插件项目。
dsh-enterprise-suite 使用前须知：Atlassian live 模式向配置站点发送 Confluence 搜索和 Jira 读写请求，并解析凭据引用；默认使用 mock 模式。

dsh-enterprise-suite README · DeepSeek Harness Enterprise Suite：Open-source enterprise integrations, governance controls, and plugin templates for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The suite provides a secure starting point for organizations that want agent access to internal systems without placing connector credentials, authorization policy, and audit logic inside individual prompts or agent loops.

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Included plugins：| Plugin | Capabilities | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Atlassian | Confluence search; Jira read, create, and deterministic issue review | Working; mock and live modes |
| Enterprise policy | Project and space allowlists, configurable DLP checks, approval-gated Jira writes | Working |
| Enterprise audit | Redacted owner-only JSONL records from final tool outcomes | Working |

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Included plugins：The repository also includes a plugin generator, reusable connector utilities, a machine-readable enterprise plugin catalog, deployment guidance, a threat model, and starter templates for new connectors and policy plugins.

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Install：DeepSeek Harness is currently a developer preview. Pin both Harness and this suite to reviewed versions or commits.

From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout:

```sh
export DSH_HOME=/absolute/path/to/an/evaluation-home
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:mickymultani/deepseek-harness-enterprise-suite#v0.1.0
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
pnpm dsh web --no-open

For local development:

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/mickymultani/deepseek-harness-enterprise-suite.git
cd deepseek-harness-enterprise-suite
pnpm install
pnpm test

The bundle starts in mock Atlassian mode. It cannot modify a real tenant until an operator explicitly changes the profile configuration to `mode: live` and supplies credential references.

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Configure live Atlassian access：Create an override at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`. Harness patch rows replace the complete config, so include every field:

```yaml
- id: enterprise-atlassian
  config:
    mode: live
    baseUrl: https://your-company.atlassian.net

Configuration contains references, never credential values. Resolve those references with the Harness credential provider, an injected process environment, or a custom provider backed by the enterprise vault.

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Create a plugin：Generate a standalone connector plugin:

```sh
npx dsh-enterprise-suite create-dsh-enterprise-plugin knowledge-search
```

The generated project includes an installable bundle manifest, typed canonical tool output, configuration validation, cancellation-aware HTTP, tests, and documentation prompts. See [Creating a plugin](docs/CREATING_A_PLUGIN.md) and the [connector contract](docs/CONNECTOR_CONTRACT.md).

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Design principles：- Separate read, propose, approve, execute, and verify operations.
- Resolve credentials for every external operation and never log their values.
- Treat retrieved enterprise content as untrusted data, not instructions.
- Put deterministic authorization in policy plugins, not model judgment.
- Make writes idempotent, approval-gated, cancellation-aware, and externally verified.
- Produce structured canonical values; keep prose in renderers.
- Record authoritative final outcomes with redaction and retention controls.
- Pin, review, scan, sign, and canary every plugin release.

dsh-enterprise-suite README · Project status：The shared plugin foundation and included plugins are suitable for evaluation. A production deployment must still validate its own tenant APIs, field mappings, identity propagation, approval experience, retention rules, regulatory controls, availability targets, and incident procedures. Capability status is tracked explicitly in the [plugin catalog](docs/PLUGIN_CATALOG.md).
